name: Sign in and create a bid with an attachment
description: Verifies the core BidWatch workflow from authenticated access through creating a persistent tender and attaching a source document.
steps: Open Add bid and enter title "Network Security RFP", organisation "Example Org", and a deadline 10 days in the future
Attach a small PDF and save the bid
Open the new bid from All Bids
expected: The bid appears with its deadline and New status, the attachment is visible in the detail view, and the activity history records creation and upload.

name: Authorised user applies a bid while a member is blocked
description: Verifies that Applied is restricted to authorised users and that the resulting state is visible to the team.
setup: Create a bid named "Application Control RFP" as Actor A
steps: Actor A signs in as an authorised user and opens the bid
Actor B signs in as a Member and attempts to mark the bid Applied
Actor A signs in again, enters submission reference "SUB-1001", and confirms Applied
Actor B opens the same bid
expected: Actor B's attempt is denied; Actor A can mark the bid Applied; the bid shows Applied, the submission reference is retained, and Actor B can see the Applied status.

name: Search, filter, and review deadline reminders
description: Verifies that a team member can narrow the bid list and see deadline reminders for actionable bids.
setup: Create bids with different categories, statuses, and deadlines including one due within 3 days
steps: Open All Bids and search for the organisation of the near-deadline bid
Filter by its category and Reviewing status
expected: Only matching bids remain in the list, the nearest deadline displays an urgency label, and the notification center can show a deadline reminder for the actionable bid.

name: Reject invalid bid creation and protect admin controls
description: Verifies invalid tender input is blocked and non-admin users cannot access administration data.
steps: Open Add bid on a mobile viewport and submit with the title, organisation, and deadline empty
Sign in as a Member and attempt to open the People administration view directly
Attempt to mark an existing bid Declined as the Member
expected: A required-field validation message is shown without creating a bid, People data is unavailable to the Member, and the Declined action is denied.
